    m = len(combined)

    for i in range(1, m):
        j = failure[i - 1]
        while j > 0 and combined[i] != combined[j]:
            j = failure[j - 1]
        if combined[i] == combined[j]:
            j += 1
        failure[i] = j

    max_len = max(failure)
